policy: V1.3 Phase 2 re-audited exact repository commits, selected paths, Git blobs, canonical-LF SHA-256 values, import closures, license closures, runtime traces, disable switches and rollback. Three permitted OpenChatBI/Wren source files are vendored byte-identically, while IBM selected source executes only from an external fixed checkout after commit and per-file hash verification. No reviewed UI, logo, model credential, database connector or restricted asset is vendored.
